question: If the creature with mentor leaves the battlefield while mentor is on the stack, is its power as it last existed used to decide whether the target has lesser power?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you use its power as it last existed on the battlefield.
expected.answer: If the creature with mentor leaves the battlefield with mentor on the stack, use its power as that creature last existed on the battlefield to determine whether the target creature has less power.
